title: trailboss --json task accept
description: What accepting does, a row per step: would fast-forward / fast-forwarded (the base branch to the task's branch, in the checkout it started from), would remove / removed (its worktree), would delete / deleted (its branch), note (its agent is still open in a removed folder), failed. Refused (an error, no rows) unless the base branch is checked out and clean there, can fast-forward, the worktree has nothing uncommitted, and the agent isn't working. Frontends should show an action they don't know as is.

action.description: would fast-forward, fast-forwarded, would remove, removed, would delete, deleted, note or failed; more may be added.
